howto.what: Claude 会使用 Vercel AI SDK 的 generateText、streamText、Output.object、tool 等函数，帮你生成文本、流式输出、结构化数据（JSON/数组）和工具调用，并支持 OpenAI、Anthropic 等 20 多个 AI 提供商。
howto.when: 当你要求构建 AI 聊天界面、生成结构化数据、实现工具调用或搭建 RAG 应用时触发。

say.text: 用 Vercel AI SDK 写一个流式聊天接口。
帮我用 Zod 定义输出结构，提取菜谱的步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude will use Vercel AI SDK functions like generateText, streamText, Output.object, and tool to generate text, stream responses, produce structured data (JSON/arrays), and call tools, supporting 20+ providers including OpenAI and Anthropic.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build AI chat interfaces, generate structured data, implement tool calling, or set up RAG applications.

say_en.text: Write a streaming chat endpoint using Vercel AI SDK.
say_en.note: Claude will generate code using streamText and useChat.

say_en.text: Define a Zod schema to extract recipe steps as structured output.
say_en.note: Claude will use Output.object with a Zod schema.
